import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def calculate_macd(data, short_window=12, long_window=26, signal_window=9):
    data['EMA_S'] = data['Adj Close'].ewm(span=short_window, min_periods=1).mean()
    data['EMA_L'] = data['Adj Close'].ewm(span=long_window, min_periods=1).mean()
    data['MACD'] = data['EMA_S'] - data['EMA_L']
    data['MACD_Signal'] = data['MACD'].ewm(span=signal_window, min_periods=1).mean()
    return data

def detect_bullish_divergence(data, periods=[3, 5, 10], tolerance=0.01):
    signals = {}

    today_price = data.iloc[-1]['Adj Close']
    today_macd = data.iloc[-1]['MACD']

    for period in periods:
        if len(data) > period:
            past_price = data.iloc[-period]['Adj Close']
            past_macd = data.iloc[-period]['MACD']

            price_divergence = today_price < past_price
            macd_divergence = today_macd > past_macd * (1 - tolerance)

            if price_divergence and macd_divergence:
                signals[period] = True
            else:
                signals[period] = False
    return signals

def find_divergence(symbol, start, end, periods=[3, 5, 10], tolerance=0.01):
    data = yf.download(symbol, start=start, end=end, interval='1d')
    if data.empty:
        print(f"{symbol} için veri bulunamadı.")
        return None

    data = calculate_macd(data)
    signals = detect_bullish_divergence(data, periods, tolerance)

    for period, signal in signals.items():
        if signal:
            print(f"{symbol}: {period} gün önceki fiyat ile pozitif uyumsuzluk bulundu!")
        else:
            print(f"{symbol}: {period} gün önceki fiyat ile pozitif uyumsuzluk bulunamadı.")
    return data

def plot_macd_with_price(data, lookback_days=5):
    today = data.iloc[-1]
    past = data.iloc[-lookback_days] if len(data) > lookback_days else None

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
    ax1.plot(data.index, data['MACD'], label='MACD', color='blue')
    ax1.plot(data.index, data['MACD_Signal'], label='MACD_Signal', color='green')
    ax1.set_ylabel('MACD', color='blue')

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.plot(data.index, data['Adj Close'], label='Fiyat', color='orange', linestyle='--')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Fiyat', color='orange')
    ax1.scatter(today.name, today['MACD'], color='blue', label=f"Bugünkü MACD ({today['MACD']:.2f})")
    ax1.scatter(today.name, today['MACD_Signal'], color='green', label=f"Bugünkü MACD_Signal ({today['MACD_Signal']:.2f})")

    if past is not None:
        ax1.scatter(past.name, past['MACD'], color='orange', label=f"{lookback_days} gün önce MACD ({past['MACD']:.2f})")
        ax1.scatter(past.name, past['MACD_Signal'], color='red', label=f"{lookback_days} gün önce MACD_Signal ({past['MACD_Signal']:.2f})")

    plt.title(f"Signal Line Crossover ve {lookback_days} gün önceki değerlerle fiyat karşılaştırması", fontsize=15)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()
